scene_summary: A dark field of fine horizontal contour lines gathers into a pale, sharply rising central relief. The surrounding stepped ridges are interrupted by black cutaways and a few small colored glints.
usable_surfaces: central pale peak and descending contour
black notch at the rightward ridge break
thin pale contour along the central lower slope
small colored glints on the upper-right ridge
isolated colored lights in dark apertures

detected_objects.label: Central pale relief
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A tall, pale lavender-white peak with a narrow summit and layered, descending contours occupies the center; its edges are visibly defined against the dark horizontal-line field.

detected_objects.label: Broken lower trace
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A broad, irregular lavender-white ridge descends from the central relief and continues rightward as a broken bright trace over darker contour bands.

detected_objects.label: Stepped left ridge
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The left-side contour rises in blocky steps, then meets a sharp dark interruption and a short horizontal ledge before the central relief.

detected_objects.label: Fine contour glint
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A narrow pale contour curls across the lower face of the central peak, distinct from the broader bright ridge beneath it.

detected_objects.label: Upper ridge fragment
detected_objects.visual_evidence: An ascending set of fine contours crosses the upper-right field and ends in a stepped crest; several tiny cyan, yellow, and magenta flecks sit on its edge.

detected_objects.label: Left lower sloped trace
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A distinct sloped, pale-edged contour enters from the lower left, steps over several low mounds, and carries a few tiny colored edge flecks.

complexity_assessment.rationale: The plate is sparse and expressionist: a few broad contour masses sit in generous black negative space, with fine lines and isolated glints rather than dense competing detail.
